basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer from New Jersey. I have recently developed a keen interest in customizing leather jackets as a way to combine my love for art and music. I enjoy exploring different styles and techniques to express my individuality. When I'm not working on design projects or learning about leather customization, you can find me at the local shooting range or practicing kendo with my new katana. My online hours are usually evenings and weekends. I'm currently single and enjoy my independence.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and have spent several years working in digital media. My interest in leather jackets is relatively new, sparked by a love for music and personal expression. Most of my knowledge about jackets and patchwork comes from online communities and YouTube tutorials.
